arStrings.szText:
When you Shapeshift into either Werewolf or Werebear form, you gain {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} seconds. Additionally, {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} second while active.

{c_important}{u}Berserking's{/u}{/c} damage bonus is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" * 100|+%|]{/c}.
